<div style={{marginTop: 40}}>
    <h3>FAQ</h3>

        <b>Is the project ready to use? </b>- Yes, but all components are being worked on and might change with updates.
        No worries though, [we'll announce](https://taxify.slack.com/archives/C030G4M2CRX)
        all breaking changes and provide assistance with the migrations.


        <b>I'd like to get started, how can I add Kalep React to my project?</b> - Check out our
        [README](https://github.com/bolteu/kalep/blob/main/packages/kalep-react/README.md)
        in Github for more details.


        <b>Something seems broken, what should I do? </b>- Report it to{" "}
        [our support channel](https://taxify.slack.com/archives/C034P1EFKDF)
        and if you know a fix, feel free to open a PR!


        <b>I am missing some features, can I get them? </b>- Similarly to bugs, feature requests are welcome
        [in Slack](https://taxify.slack.com/archives/C034P1EFKDF). We also welcome contributions and have a [contribution guide](https://github.com/bolteu/kalep/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
        that highlights our best practices in case if you are willing to implement the feature yourself. However, please
        give us a heads-up first to make sure noone is doing double work.

</div>
